title: Middle Eastern Tequenos
description: A flavorful Middle Eastern twist on the Venezuelan tequenos, perfect for a quick snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Halloumi Cheese
ingredients.notes: preferably Middle Eastern or Greek style

instructions: Cut pita bread into 1-inch wide strips.
Thread 2-3 strips of pita bread onto each skewer, leaving a little space between each piece.
Thread a cube of cheese onto each skewer, followed by a few pieces of pita bread.
Brush pita bread with olive oil and season with garlic powder and salt (if using).
Place skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until pita bread is golden brown and cheese is melted.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro, lemon juice, and toasted pine nuts (if using).
Serve hot with a side of Zatar (if using).
